description: Account ingestion status scenarios (issues #296/#297). Each `snapshot` is the server read model input and `status` the exact GET /api/v1/ingestion-status `data` it derives. Clients assert their presentation against `status` and `clientExpectation`. See docs/ingestion-status.md.

scenarios.description: A new account four pages into its first Strava summary scan. Nothing has been enriched yet and the total history size is not known.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Show history as importing with the known count only; never show a percentage or a total.

scenarios.description: History is complete. Most details and streams are imported; a few detail fetches failed and back off, some activities have no GPS or sensor streams, and some streams failed permanently.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Even when this device has synced every stored activity, show details and streams as still importing. Activities without streams are complete, not missing.

scenarios.description: Everything is imported. Some activities are manual or indoor with no GPS route, and some recorded no sensor streams.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Show everything as up to date. Activities without a route or streams are not pending work.

scenarios.description: The only pending details failed recently and are backing off.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Show the remaining details as waiting until retryAt, not as stuck or failed forever.

scenarios.description: Strava rejected the stored credentials during the last enrichment run and for stream backfill; the grant has not changed since.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Offer reconnecting Strava. Do not suggest retrying or waiting.

scenarios.description: The same account after reconnecting: the grant changed after the rejected run, so work is scheduled again before the next run reports.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Stop offering reconnect; show the work as scheduled. The last outcome still describes the earlier rejected run.

scenarios.description: A rescan stopped at the Strava rate limit and every outstanding stream is waiting for its retry time.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Explain that ActivityMap is waiting for Strava limits and continues automatically; no action is needed.

scenarios.description: Summary reconciliation has not run for five hours, stream backfill is switched off on the server, and the legacy sync job has never reported.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Say automatic import is currently paused or unavailable rather than implying progress. Users cannot fix this themselves.

scenarios.description: The athlete deauthorized ActivityMap on Strava. Stored data remains until erasure, but no import work can continue.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Show the account as disconnected with a reconnect action; keep showing what was imported.

scenarios.description: Everything is imported except photo metadata for a few activities, which the last run could not refresh.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Show photos as needing a refresh that is not automatic; everything else is up to date.

scenarios.description: A status the client fetched three hours ago and is still displaying offline.
scenarios.clientExpectation: Present it as the last known status as of observedAt; do not present its scheduling as current.
